about_the_game:
The Shipper's Gambit: A Puzzle-Comedy FMV Game

Stage the ultimate game of love in The Shipper's Gambit, a Puzzle-Comedy FMV game that casts you as the master "Planner" behind the romance. Pull the strings of destiny, orchestrate scenarios, and manipulate events to make your dream pairing a reality. The stage is yours... Shipper!

Inspired by the global sensation of Thai BL (Boys' Love) series, The Shipper's Gambit invites you to become the architect of affection. Forget about being the main character—this is your platform to prove your genius for planning from behind the scenes!

Execute the Perfect "Game of Love"

As the unseen hand shaping the romantic plot, your mission is to create the most perfect conditions for love to bloom. Analyze the situation, plan shrewdly, and select the choices that will push the two male leads closer together. Every decision is a crucial move in your game of love. Will you outwit fate and guide them to a beautiful ending, or will your carefully crafted plan fall hilariously apart?

A game measured by wit, heart, and a whole lot of comedy.

Key Features

  • Full-Scale Live-Action FMV — Interactive Gaming at Its Finest — Experience every emotion through real footage and performances from actual actors. Every scenario you orchestrate unfolds before your eyes in real-time. 

  • Diverse & Charming Characters, Each With Unique Personalities and Hidden Depths — Every character harbors secrets and stories waiting to be discovered, as you strategically engineer their perfect encounters.

  • Branching Paths and Multiple Endings — Whether you mastermind the ultimate romantic happy ending or hilariously bungle your plans into legendary chaos... it all depends on you.

  • Contemporary Thai Atmosphere — Vibrant Yet Subtly Mysterious — Romance intertwines with the enigmas of the human heart. A tale of shipping and scheming unlike anything you've experienced before.

  • Intriguing Yet Cautionary... Plan Your Moves Carefully — Every decision carries weight. Every strategy can shift the tide. Are you ready to unveil the art of matchmaking to the world?

short_description: In love's shadows, you alone see the truth. Two souls destined, yet unaware. As The Shipper's Gambit's Heart Strategist, you control each moment, craft romantic scenarios, and manipulate fate unseen. More than FMV Puzzle-Comedy—this is the ultimate art of bringing hearts together.
